prompt: Draft requirements and acceptance criteria for a bulk finance export. The request says only that finance needs a downloadable report. Requester roles, permitted account scope, fields, retention policy, legal approval, maximum export size, data owner, and decision date are not supplied. Ask for the minimum blocking inputs and do not invent policy or defaults.
assertions: identify the minimum blocking product and authority inputs
separate known request from unknown policy
avoid ready criteria that depend on missing decisions
